proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E470b Magnesium Salts of Fatty Acids
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E470b (magnesium salts of fatty acids / magnesium stearate) as Mushbooh (doubtful): the fatty acids may be plant- or animal-derived, so the source must be checked to determine halal status.

proposed.sourceName: Council of Islamic Organizations of Greater Chicago (CIOGC) — 'List of Halal and Haram Food Ingredients'
proposed.paraphrase: CIOGC's published ingredient list (from Hussaini & Sakr, 'Islamic Dietary Laws and Practices') rules magnesium stearate / stearic acid 'Haram when derived from animal source' — under the strictest position, unspecified-origin E470 whose fatty acids may be animal-derived is therefore avoided.
